answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 9635 Country: MU Title: Alhamdullillah I try to do one para daur daily (in about an hour) and try to finish it again in my salaah. To learn the daur I first read the first 2 pages from the Quraan then I recite it by heart, I continue like this till I have completed the whole para. Then if my mind does not feel too tired, I read the whole para again from memory, thereafter I do my sabak daur. This is the method that I have devised but I wanted to know the proper method of learning daur as Huffaz do in the Madaaris. A student told me that I can learn ruku by ruku, this does not seem so appropriete for me as sometimes the ruku is too short and sometimes too long. 2. What is the detailed method of learning sabak and daur at Dar ul uloom Deoband? 2. When I am doing my daur without moving the lips during haidh for 6 days, should I do those daur again or should I rather continue from where I reached as when I do those 6 days daur immediately after taking ghusl, I find it much easier than when I have to learn a normal daur as I have just done it. Question: Assalamualaikum Wa Rahmatullahi Wa Barakatuh 1. Alhamdullillah I try to do one para daur daily (in about an hour) and try to finish it again in my salaah. To learn the daur I first read the first 2 pages from the Quraan then I recite it by heart, I continue like this till I have completed the whole para. Then if my mind does not feel too tired, I read the whole para again from memory, thereafter I do my sabak daur. This is the method that I have devised but I wanted to know the proper method of learning daur as Huffaz do in the Madaaris. A student told me that I can learn ruku by ruku, this does not seem so appropriete for me as sometimes the ruku is too short and sometimes too long. 2. What is the detailed method of learning sabak and daur at Dar ul uloom Deoband? 2. When I am doing my daur without moving the lips during haidh for 6 days, should I do those daur again or should I rather continue from where I reached as when I do those 6 days daur immediately after taking ghusl, I find it much easier than when I have to learn a normal daur as I have just done it. Jazakumullah Answer ID: 9635 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2326/D=161/K=1429) (1, 2) Ma-shaAllah, your method of daur is very nice. The hafizs in madrasas do like this, It is good method. If there is any other easier method you can adopt it too. You can recite ruku by ruku if you feel easy. If a ruku is small and you recite it in first rakah then you should recite two ruku together. (3) Tilawah (recitation of the Quran) is not valid without moving tongue and lips; therefore repeat those parts later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
